plugin.setup.commandsBody: Each runs in the plugin's own process, round by round, and what it asks is answered here. At a terminal, `daoris {{id}} <command>` runs the same.
plugin.setup.offWhole: The plugin is off or refused, so none of its commands runs.
plugin.setup.offHere: Its commands are switched off at {{place}}.
plugin.setup.storageBody: A folder of its own, handed to its processes alone; Daoris reads nothing in it, and removing the plugin deletes it.
plugin.setup.forget: Removing it asks it to sign out first, by `{{command}}`.
plugin.setup.forgetNot: Removing it does not ask it to sign out: {{why}}
plugin.setup.viewsBody: Daoris draws a view from what the plugin answers; this build lists them and draws none yet.
plugin.setup.viewWhere.side: as a side bar tab you add
plugin.setup.viewContext.session: It is told which session you are looking at.
plugin.setup.viewContext.quest: It is told which quest you are looking at.
plugin.setup.unknown: It names parts this build does not know, each skipped: {{names}}.
plugin.setup.onBody: Each part is on everywhere until you switch it off. A repository's word wins over its workspace's, and a workspace's over this machine's; storage is switched at this machine alone.
